description: Proposed and pending amendments to the federal court rules, grouped by the date they are projected to take effect (for example December 1, 2027), from the U.S. Courts "Pending Rules and Forms Amendments" page. Answers "which Federal Rules of Civil Procedure will be amended effective December 1, 2027", "what rule changes are coming", "which appellate, bankruptcy, criminal or evidence rules are being amended". Returns one row per projected effective date with the rule and form numbers for each rule set (civil, appellate, bankruptcy, criminal, evidence), the stage the page shows (published for comment, Standing Committee report, Supreme Court package, Congressional package), the verbatim line, and the fetch date. Optional filters: rule_set, effective_date.

effective_date.description: Projected effective date: 2027-12-01, "December 1, 2027", or a year such as 2027.

rule_set.description: Keep only this rule set: civil (FRCP), appellate (FRAP), bankruptcy (FRBP), criminal (FRCrP) or evidence (FRE).

name: federal_rules_pending_amendments
title: Federal Rules Pending Amendments
